splash-booru._comment: booru-tag anime bases (Animagine). Positive carries ArtStation posing vocab (line-of-action / twist / low hero angle) plus a FACE-REALISM block measured 2026-08-16 (semi-realistic / realistic face / detailed skin), which moved this base's rendering register from 0.153 BELOW the 0.8373 corpus self-similarity ceiling to 0.003 below it while subject_cos and margin both improved. Negative leads with the ANTI-DOLL block from the same study (flat color / cel shading / doll face / plastic skin / smooth featureless skin): the positive alone gets register 0.7958, the negative carries it the rest of the way to 0.8344, and dropping 'cel shading' costs 0.013 register while buying NO sharpness back (measured, C3 - the softness comes from the rest of the block, not from that tag). ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: this negative is 103 tokens against CLIP's 77-token window, so everything past position 76 is silently discarded. It is sorted by priority - anti-doll, quality core, text/signature/watermark, anatomy core, glasses, pose - so the tokens that fall off the end are the REDUNDANT finger/limb duplicates and the score tags, not the signature guard. Do not reorder without re-running the token count. 'photorealistic, 3d render' were DELETED: measured to sit past the cut (inert) and they oppose the face-realism direction. Positive is 79 tokens and drops only 'absurdres'. Champion-specific canon (e.g. 'yellow eyes' for Ahri) belongs in the brief's prompt_extra, NOT here - this block is champion-agnostic. Evidence: docs/GEN_FACE_REALISM_2026-08-16.md.
